steps.name: environment
steps.description: Verify node/npm presence and sqlite3 system package; warn if node major version is lower than recommended for Electron 25 (do not hard-fail), and write DISPLAY persistence to /etc/profile.d only if absent or different to preserve idempotency. Use non-interactive apt installs and a small retry for apt races. Allow skipping node version check via NOTES_SKIP_NODE_CHECK=1 for image-provided node.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/personal-notes-manager-283697-283706/notes_native_app"
# verify node/npm present (preinstalled in image); warn on version mismatch but do not hard-fail
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 3; }
NODE_V=$(node -v | sed 's/^v//')
NODE_MAJOR=${NODE_V%%.*}
RECOMMENDED_NODE_MAJOR=22
if [ "${NOTES_SKIP_NODE_CHECK:-0}" != "1" ] && [ "${NODE_MAJOR}" -lt "$RECOMMENDED_NODE_MAJOR" ]; then
  echo "warning: node version $NODE_V is older than recommended >=${RECOMMENDED_NODE_MAJOR}.x for electron@25; continuing (set NOTES_SKIP_NODE_CHECK=1 to override)" >&2
fi
# ensure sqlite3 present; idempotent install with small retry loop
if ! command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
  for i in 1 2 3; do sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q sqlite3 && break || sleep 1; done
fi
# idempotent write of DISPLAY into /etc/profile.d (do not overwrite if identical)
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/notes_native_display.sh
TMP=/tmp/notes_native_display.$$
cat > "$TMP" <<'EOF'
# notes_native_app display env (managed by setup script)
export DISPLAY=:99
EOF
if [ ! -f "$PROFILE" ] || ! sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$PROFILE"; then sudo mv -f "$TMP" "$PROFILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"; else rm -f "$TMP"; fi
# print minimal verification
node -v && npm -v && (command -v sqlite3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && sqlite3 --version || true)

steps.name: install dependencies
steps.description: Install npm dependencies deterministically and verify installations by running local binaries. Prefer npm ci when package-lock.json exists; if absent, create package-lock deterministically then run npm ci. Ensure NODE_ENV is not 'production' so devDependencies install. Capture npm install logs to /tmp on failure for diagnostics.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/personal-notes-manager-283697-283706/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
: "Ensure NODE_ENV not production so devDependencies are installed"
export NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-development}
# deterministic install: prefer npm ci if lock exists; otherwise generate package-lock then npm ci
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || { npm install --no-audit --no-fund > /tmp/npm_install.log 2>&1; echo "npm ci failed; see /tmp/npm_install.log" >&2; exit 6; }
else
  npm i --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund || { npm i --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund > /tmp/npm_install.log 2>&1; echo "package-lock generation failed; see /tmp/npm_install.log" >&2; exit 6; }
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || { npm install --no-audit --no-fund > /tmp/npm_install.log 2>&1; echo "npm ci failed after lock generation; see /tmp/npm_install.log" >&2; exit 6; }
fi
# verification by running local binaries to check they execute and report versions
if ! ./node_modules/.bin/electron --version > /tmp/notes_electron_version.txt 2>&1; then echo "electron failed to run; see /tmp/notes_electron_version.txt" >&2; tail -n 200 /tmp/notes_electron_version.txt || true; exit 7; fi
if ! ./node_modules/.bin/jest --version > /tmp/notes_jest_version.txt 2>&1; then echo "jest failed to run; see /tmp/notes_jest_version.txt" >&2; tail -n 200 /tmp/notes_jest_version.txt || true; exit 8; fi

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Build (no-op) and run the Electron app via the local electron binary. Ensure required runtime libs are present; REQUIRED_PKGS can be overridden via VALIDATION_PKGS to avoid installing both GTK3 and GTK4. Start the app, wait for NOTES_APP_READY marker within timeout, capture logs and evidence, resolve actual native electron binary for ldd diagnostics when needed, and perform graceful shutdown with timeout.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/personal-notes-manager-283697-283706/notes_native_app"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
# allow override of runtime packages to keep installs minimal (e.g. only GTK3)
DEFAULT_PKGS=(libgtk-3-0 libgdk-pixbuf2.0-0 libx11-6 libxss1 libasound2 libnss3 libgbm1 fonts-noto-color-emoji)
IFS=',' read -r -a REQUIRED_PKGS <<< "${VALIDATION_PKGS:-$(printf "%s," "${DEFAULT_PKGS[@]}")}"; REQUIRED_PKGS=(${REQUIRED_PKGS[@]})
MISSING=()
for p in "${REQUIRED_PKGS[@]}"; do dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || MISSING+=("$p"); done
if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -ne 0 ]; then for i in 1 2 3; do sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -q "${MISSING[@]}" && break || sleep 1; done; fi
# build (no-op)
npm run build --silent >/dev/null || true
export DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:99}
TMPLOG=/tmp/notes_native_app.log
: >"$TMPLOG"
# start app using local electron
./node_modules/.bin/electron . >"$TMPLOG" 2>&1 &
APP_PID=$!
TIMEOUT=${VALIDATION_TIMEOUT:-60}
READY=0
for i in $(seq 1 "$TIMEOUT"); do
  if grep -q 'NOTES_APP_READY' "$TMPLOG"; then READY=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
EVIDENCE=/tmp/notes_native_evidence.txt
echo "timestamp: $(date --iso-8601=seconds)" >"$EVIDENCE"
if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "status: failed" >>"$EVIDENCE"
  echo "reason: readiness marker not seen within ${TIMEOUT}s" >>"$EVIDENCE"
  echo "last log excerpt:" >>"$EVIDENCE"
  tail -n 500 "$TMPLOG" >>"$EVIDENCE" || true
  # resolve native electron binary for ldd diagnostics
  NATIVE_BIN=""
  if [ -f node_modules/electron/dist/electron ]; then NATIVE_BIN="node_modules/electron/dist/electron"; fi
  if [ -z "$NATIVE_BIN" ] && [ -L node_modules/.bin/electron ]; then NATIVE_BIN=$(readlink -f node_modules/.bin/electron || true); fi
  if [ -n "$NATIVE_BIN" ] && [ -x "$NATIVE_BIN" ]; then echo "ldd $NATIVE_BIN:" >>"$EVIDENCE"; ldd "$NATIVE_BIN" 2>&1 | tail -n 200 >>"$EVIDENCE" || true; fi
  kill "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 1
  if kill -0 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
  echo "evidence: $EVIDENCE"
  exit 9
fi
# success evidence
echo "status: success" >>"$EVIDENCE"
echo "app_pid: $APP_PID" >>"$EVIDENCE"
tail -n 200 "$TMPLOG" >>"$EVIDENCE" || true
# graceful shutdown
kill -INT "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
for i in 1 5; do
  if ! kill -0 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if kill -0 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
echo "evidence: $EVIDENCE"

change_logs.message: Refined env-01, scaffold-01, deps-01, test-01, and validation-01 to address analyst feedback: pinned electron and jest versions in package.json (scaffold-01), changed npm lifecycle usage to rely on standard npm install/ci and local binaries, removed fragile silent failure handling and '|| true' (deps-01), wrote /etc/profile.d with resolved values and only NODE_ENV+DISPLAY exports (env-01), added explicit check/install of Chromium runtime libs before validation (validation-01), added deterministic jest devDependency and improved test execution to capture output (test-01), made validation use log-grep readiness and longer wait. These changes address deterministic installs, PATH/profile correctness, dependency checks for Electron, removal of error-swallowing, and improved validation evidence.

Refined env-01, scaffold-01, deps-01, test-01, and validation-01 to address analyst feedback: added Node/npm version checks (CRITICAL) and fail-fast guidance; made /etc/profile.d writes idempotent and limited to DISPLAY only (avoided global NODE_ENV); added DEBIAN_FRONTEND and dpkg options for apt installs and a small apt-lock retry; changed dependency verification to deterministic checks of ./node_modules/.bin/electron and ./node_modules/.bin/jest rather than npx --no-install; ensured package-lock persistence and warn/fail if absent after install; updated test step to run local jest binary and capture summarized exit code and logs; expanded Chromium runtime libs list and added ldd diagnostics when Electron fails to start; improved validation evidence with timestamps and explicit success/failure markers; added graceful shutdown wrapper logic with timeout. These changes address compatibility, determinism, idempotency, and diagnostic gaps called out by the analyst.

Refined steps env-01, scaffold-01, deps-01, test-01, and validation-01 to address analyst feedback: (1) env-01: changed node version check to warn instead of hard-fail, allow override via NOTES_SKIP_NODE_CHECK, added idempotent /etc/profile.d write (only if absent or different) and implemented a short apt retry for sqlite3; (2) scaffold-01: replaced npx in package.json start with deterministic local invocation './node_modules/.bin/electron .', left NODE_ENV set in scripts but emphasized project-local usage, retained GUI behavior to keep window open; (3) deps-01: removed -x binary checks and instead run './node_modules/.bin/electron --version' and jest --version to verify installation, ensured NODE_ENV not production during install, prefer npm ci when package-lock exists and generate package-lock deterministically when absent, capture npm logs on failure to /tmp/npm_install.log; (4) test-01: extended smoke test to attempt opening the SQLite DB via the sqlite3 binary if present (falls back to file existence), and keep test runner using local jest binary; (5) validation-01: added resolution of native electron binary path (node_modules/electron/dist/electron) before running ldd, made REQUIRED_PKGS configurable via VALIDATION_PKGS env var to avoid installing both GTK3 and GTK4 unnecessarily, improved process shutdown checks and evidence capture. These changes address all CRITICAL and HIGH recommendations (no hard-fail on node version, remove npx, reliable verification of installs, correct ldd target, idempotent profile writes) and several MEDIUM/LOW recommendations for determinism and diagnostics.
